brief: 'Pretty cottage' of about 1940, five rooms: a one-and-a-half-storey side-gabled Cape Cod with white clapboard, dark shutters, a centre door under a small hood and a stepped walk up a terraced front lawn; a 1940s sedan at the curb.

facade.notes: (Middletown OH appraisal snapshot, scalloped-edge print): a 1940 Cape-like minimal traditional house with a centred front gable over the door, shutters and window boxes, a 'for sale' sign; the lawn banked up from the sidewalk with concrete steps; a 1940s car at the curb

why.note: lots raised above the walk on banks with steps
